descriptionTeaser: We are looking for an R&D Intern to contribute to innovative coatings projects, focusing on polymer chemistry or material science. You will work on research projects in wood or metal substrates, gaining hands-on experience in laboratory settings. Ideal for students with a passion for coatings and research, seeking a 6–12 month placement.
